children: Circle8 confirmed a preliminary, non-binding proposal to acquire SThree to accelerate its global IT and technology strategy while avoiding dilution to existing shareholders.
Submitted a preliminary, non-binding and highly indicative cash proposal for SThree plc to pursue a possible acquisition.
Transaction structured to be financed without issuing additional Circle8 common stock, so existing shareholders would not be diluted.
SThree reported ~£1.3B gross revenue in fiscal 2025; combined gross revenues could approach $3B.
Circle8 says combination would expand geographic reach, bolster tech capabilities across AI, cloud, cybersecurity and engineering.
Process is at an early stage with no certainty a firm offer will be made or that any transaction will complete.

title: Circle8 Confirms Preliminary Proposal for SThree, Seeks $3B Combined Scale Without Share Dilution
